title.zh: CFTC Lets Coinbase Turn 25-Year Index Futures Into Contracts That Never Expire
title.en: CFTC Lets Coinbase Turn 25-Year Index Futures Into Contracts That Never Expire

current_state.zh: The CFTC has allowed Coinbase to convert its 25-year index futures into perpetual, never-expiring contracts, opening the door for crypto-style perpetual futures in the US regulated derivatives market.
current_state.en: The CFTC has allowed Coinbase to convert its 25-year index futures into perpetual, never-expiring contracts, opening the door for crypto-style perpetual futures in the US regulated derivatives market.
